notes.axes: Exposure and substitution are independent (r=0.03) and are never blended into one displayed number. Both are percentiles over the 821 scored, non-managerial O*NET occupations.
notes.market_jobs: An O*NET role carries the job market of the SOC2020 unit groups it belongs to: openings summed, pay and growth weighted by openings. Roles sharing a parent show identical market data.
notes.market_units: Degrees and apprenticeships take pay and the axes from the broad map (where people end up) and openings, entrants and competition from the narrow map (what the qualification trains for), so entrants divided by openings reproduces the published competition.
